title: hyvv run-command job request (DRAFT, not frozen)
description: Draft request shape for POST /v1/attempts with the proposed kind run-command. DESIGN-ONLY: this file describes a proposed kind gate, not an implemented endpoint; nothing here is authorized for implementation without the owner approvals listed in docs/design/r4-run-command.md. The transport boundary keeps validate_brief unchanged; the strict choices in this draft describe the kind-specific gate a future implementation would enforce.

kind.description: Dispatch reads the top-level kind first; this draft pins the canonical top-level form.

attempt_id.description: Optional. When omitted the launcher mints one (existing behavior); the pattern matches both client-supplied and minted shapes.

model.description: Must be absent or null: a run-command attempt has no inference, and a named model is refused by the kind gate (400).

tier.description: Same rule as model; tiers are model resolution and do not apply to this kind.

objective.description: Required non-empty statement of what the single command is for (validate_brief requires it non-empty after trimming).

kind.description: Optional echo of the kind; the top-level field wins at dispatch.

command.description: The single command, byte-exact. It must equal one enrolled allowlist entry (no normalization, no prefix or wildcard) or the request is refused 403 before any attempt exists. The 2000-character cap is a draft value pending owner confirmation.

purpose.description: Draft enum pending owner confirmation. When the matched allowlist entry declares a purpose, it must equal this value.

project.description: Optional authorized project key. When present it must exist in the launcher's project registry (403 otherwise) and, when the project has a local path, the container is seeded from it exactly as check jobs are.

branch.description: Optional; seeding uses it the way check jobs do.

source_rev.description: Optional; exact-revision seeding, the way check jobs do it.

security_profile.description: Optional; resolved like check jobs (the default profile unless the host defines others). When the matched allowlist entry pins a profile, the request must name the same one.

timeout_s.description: Per-command clock bounds mirrored from CHECK_TIMEOUT_S. The kind gate refuses out-of-range values (400) instead of silently clamping; a draft decision pending owner confirmation.

commands.description: Forbidden: a run-command attempt runs exactly one command; multi-command work belongs to kind=check.

verify_of.description: Forbidden: verify_of applies to opencode attempts only, as for check jobs today.

assigned_files.description: Forbidden: there is no patch and no file collection, so a file scope has no meaning for this kind.

workdir.description: Forbidden: the reused container path chooses the working directory (the seeded /work/<project> when a project is named).
